title: Batista2022: Motor-imagery EEG during NeuRow VR/haptics BCI training
description: This dataset contains EEG recordings, along with PPG, respiration, ECG and accelerometry, from 20 healthy volunteers performing cued left- versus right-hand motor imagery of a bimanual rowing task. Sessions were part of brain-computer interface training in the NeuRow environment, comparing Graz and virtual-reality conditions with optional haptic and head-mounted-display feedback. The data are a BIDS re-release of the original Zenodo deposit, produced via MOABB, for neurorehabilitation-oriented BCI research.
methods_description: EEG was recorded at 500 Hz from 32 active Ag/AgCl electrodes (actiCAP, LiveAmp 32, BrainVision Recorder) plus ECG, respiration and auxiliary channels. Each participant completed one lab session with up to five imagery runs (MI, MIMO, MIMOHP, MIMOVR, MIMOVRHP), with cue-based left/right-hand motor imagery trials and a 5 s imagery/feedback window.
